arguments.title: Card plan for the Receipt Ingest CLI
arguments.spec:
- This is a planning job: the deliverable is `plan/cards.json`, a dependency-linked set of cards an implementation team would pick up for the Receipt Ingest CLI (`input/specification.md`) -- never write, scaffold, or stub the CLI itself; no code from the specification belongs in this workspace.
- Referential integrity: every `dependsOn` id is a declared card (no self-deps); every `coversObligations` id is an obligation the specification declares (OBL-01..OBL-12); every card covers at least one obligation.
- Sizing: at most three entries in `filesLikelyTouched` per card, and no two cards may claim the same file -- two cards editing one file is a merge conflict by construction.
- Acyclicity: the dependency graph must be a DAG.
- Edge-list agreement: `dependencies` must contain exactly the edges the cards' `dependsOn` imply -- no more, no fewer (one `{from, to}` per dependsOn entry, meaning `from` depends on `to`).
- Testability honesty: a card whose `filesLikelyTouched` contains no test-shaped path (a `test`/`tests` directory segment, or `.test.`/`.spec.` in the basename) MUST be `not_testable`; a card that does touch one MUST be `testable` -- marking a card testable with nothing to test gets it bounced and parked by the test-driven gate.
- Coverage: only checked once `"complete": true` is set, at which point every one of the twelve obligations (OBL-01..OBL-12) must be covered by some card.
- `input/specification.md` is frozen evidence (content-hashed every run) -- never edit it.
- Acceptance is the same command for both deliverable states: `npm test`, offline, no new dependencies.
arguments.plan:
1. Card `draft-card-plan` writes the full `plan/cards.json`: eleven cards walking the pipeline argument handling and file discovery, then parsing (JSON and CSV), then normalisation (amount, currency, date), then duplicate detection, then the ledger writer (sort, then atomic write), then the CLI summary/exit -- each with its own 1-2 files (an implementation module plus its test), each `testable` (every card touches a test file), each covering exactly the obligation(s) it discharges. `dependencies` lists every implied edge exactly once. `complete` stays false.
2. Card `verify-plan-coverage` (depends on `draft-card-plan`, so it inherits that branch's plan/cards.json) re-checks that all twelve obligations (OBL-01..OBL-12) are covered by some card, THEN flips `complete` to true. `npm test` must be green at 10/10 for this final state.
arguments.summary: Turn the Receipt Ingest CLI product specification into an eleven-card dependency-linked implementation plan (plan/cards.json) -- argument handling and discovery first, then JSON/CSV parsing, then amount/currency/date normalisation, then duplicate detection, then a sort-then-atomic-write ledger writer, then the CLI summary/exit -- covering all twelve specification obligations with no file collisions and an honest testability flag per card. Two chained cards: draft the full plan first, then verify coverage and flip complete to true. No CLI code is written; the plan is the deliverable.

tasks.title: Draft the full eleven-card implementation plan in plan/cards.json
tasks.prompt:
Write `plan/cards.json` only -- the full card plan, in one pass. Do not write, scaffold or stub any CLI code; no code from `input/specification.md` belongs in this workspace. This is a planning job, not a build job.

Read `input/specification.md` (twelve obligations, OBL-01..OBL-12) before writing a single card.

Referential integrity: every `dependsOn` id must be a declared card (no card depends on itself); every `coversObligations` id must be an obligation the specification declares; every card must cover at least one obligation.

Sizing: at most three entries in `filesLikelyTouched` per card (relative paths, no leading `/`, no `..`), and no two cards may claim the same file -- two cards editing one file is a merge conflict by construction.

Acyclicity: the dependency graph must be a DAG.

Edge-list agreement: `dependencies` must contain exactly the edges the cards' `dependsOn` imply -- one `{"from": "<card>", "to": "<card>"}` per `dependsOn` entry (`from` depends on `to`), no more, no fewer.

Testability honesty: a card whose `filesLikelyTouched` contains no test-shaped path (a `test`/`tests` directory segment, or `.test.`/`.spec.` in the basename) MUST be `not_testable`; a card that does touch one MUST be `testable`. Pairing each implementation file with its own test file (and marking that card `testable`) is the simplest way to stay honest here.

Suggested shape (the dependencies are mostly linear, per the specification's own guidance -- argument handling and file discovery before parsing, parsing before normalisation, normalisation before duplicate detection, and the writer last): CLI argument handling (OBL-01, OBL-02) -> watched-folder file discovery (OBL-03) -> JSON parsing (OBL-04) and CSV parsing (OBL-05) in parallel off discovery -> amount normalisation (OBL-06), currency validation (OBL-07), and date normalisation (OBL-08) in parallel off both parsers -> duplicate detection (OBL-09) off all three normalisers -> ledger sort ordering (OBL-10) -> atomic write (OBL-11) -> CLI summary line and exit code (OBL-12). That is eleven cards covering all twelve obligations with no obligation left for a later card.

Leave `"complete": false` -- the coverage-completeness pass is the next card's job.

Non-goals: do not set `complete: true`; do not edit `input/specification.md`, `test/**`, or `scripts/run-tests.mjs` (frozen evidence); do not write any actual CLI source file -- `filesLikelyTouched` paths are planned, not created.

Acceptance: `npm test` must pass (all structural checks -- shape, sizing, no file collisions, referential integrity, DAG, edge-list agreement, testability honesty -- hold regardless of `complete`).

tasks.title: Verify obligation coverage and mark the plan complete
tasks.prompt:
Verify coverage, then flip `plan/cards.json`'s `complete` to true. The plan already has all eleven cards and their dependency edges from the prior card (read it fresh -- do not assume its exact shape).

Re-derive the obligation list from `input/specification.md` (OBL-01..OBL-12) and confirm every one of them is named in some card's `coversObligations`. If any obligation is uncovered, add or adjust a card to cover it (still respecting sizing, no file collisions, and testability honesty) before declaring completion.

Once every obligation is covered, set `"complete": true`.

Non-goals: do not edit `input/specification.md`, `test/**`, or `scripts/run-tests.mjs` (frozen evidence); do not write any actual CLI source file.

Acceptance: `npm test` must pass, including the coverage check that only runs once `complete` is true.
